# SecureCodeReviews.com (SCRs) - Project Setup Instructions

## Project Overview
Modern AppSec platform with blog, services, secure code examples, vulnerability visualization, free tools, and security reports.

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 14+ (App Router)
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- shadcn/ui
- Framer Motion
- MongoDB
- NextAuth.js
